note: Written by phase S-1 (plan §6.S4). MCP image generation ran fine from this session, but fetching the result bytes from Higgsfield's CDN was blocked by this session's sandboxed egress policy (403 on any host outside the allowlist — confirmed with a live test generation and a direct curl of its result_url). A session with full network egress (the local Claude Code CLI, or a future cloud session with a broader policy) can run this manifest as-is: generate each prompt with the given model via generate_image_batch, download the four result URLs straight to the `file` paths under public/images/, no re-fetch pipeline needed since there is only one shared image per slot (plan already seeds `/images/placeholder-{vertical}.jpg`, not one file per listing).
